question: Which groups of lords are appointed as rulers of spheres in this process?
premises: Specific groups are designated for this role.
The group beginning with Krodheśa is included.
inference: Eight lords of spheres and likewise the group of eight beginning with Krodheśa are appointed.
uncertainties: Syntactic completion depends on the following verse.
plain_english: They appoint eight lords of spheres and likewise the group of eight beginning with Krodheśa.
